hints.title: How to negate the gamepad Y value
hints.content: The gamepad returns -0.75 when pushed forward. Negate it with `double power = -gamepad1.left_stick_y;` to get 0.75 (positive = forward).

hints.title: How to display motor power in telemetry
hints.content: Use `telemetry.addData("Motor Power", power);` where `power` is the variable holding the motor's power value. You can pass numbers directly as the second argument.

hints.title: Don't forget telemetry.update()
hints.content: In a LinearOpMode, telemetry data is only sent to the Driver Station when you call `telemetry.update()`. Without it, nothing appears on screen.
